verdict.rationale: Elicit has a dedicated export article. The Library exports as .ris for Zotero, Mendeley, or EndNote, and tables export as CSV, Excel, RIS, or BIB. Research Reports export as PDF or Word on any plan. However, Systematic Review table exports are limited to Pro, Scale, and Enterprise, and nothing documents a complete account-wide export or a way to leave. Missing for 10: export of all data (Research Agent sessions, chats, projects, skills, alerts, artifacts), Systematic Review table export on all plans, documented account deletion or offboarding path, independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
